title: F&B Manager – Events / Outdoor Catering
job_description:
Company Description
Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL - Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.
Job Description
Position Overview
The F&B Manager – Events & Outdoor Catering is responsible for leading and managing all banquet food and beverage operations, social celebrations, weddings, corporate events, MICE functions, and outdoor catering assignments at Fairmont Mumbai and external venues.
The role focuses on delivering exceptional luxury hospitality experiences through meticulous event planning, flawless operational execution, personalized guest service, and strong commercial performance. The incumbent will work closely with the Sales & Events, Culinary, Stewarding, and other operational teams to translate client expectations into memorable experiences that reflect Fairmont’s commitment to excellence.
The position is accountable for driving revenue growth, optimizing profitability, maintaining service and food safety standards, managing operational resources, and developing a high-performing team. Particular emphasis is placed on outdoor catering logistics, client relationship management, cost control, risk mitigation, and ensuring consistent luxury service standards across all event locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Events & Banquet Operations
Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of weddings, social celebrations, corporate conferences, gala dinners, MICE functions, and other special events.
Ensure all events are executed in accordance with approved Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), client requirements, function sheets, timelines, and hotel standards.
Conduct pre-event briefings, operational readiness checks, and post-event reviews to ensure seamless delivery.
Coordinate with Sales & Events, Culinary, Stewarding, Engineering, Housekeeping, Security, and other departments to ensure operational alignment.
Maintain exceptional standards of food presentation, table setup, service etiquette, ambience, and guest engagement.
Monitor event progress and proactively resolve operational challenges while minimizing disruption to the guest experience.
Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, and service resources are deployed based on event size, complexity, and service requirements.
2. Outdoor Catering Operations
Manage end-to-end outdoor catering operations at external venues, corporate premises, private residences, wedding locations, and other approved destinations.
Conduct venue inspections to assess infrastructure, kitchen facilities, utilities, accessibility, guest flow, safety requirements, and logistical feasibility.
Develop detailed event execution plans covering manpower, transportation, food dispatch, equipment, crockery, cutlery, linen, furniture, beverages, and service stations.
Coordinate with the Executive Chef and Culinary team to ensure food quality, safe transportation, temperature control, timely delivery, and appropriate presentation at external venues.
Supervise loading, dispatch, setup, service, replenishment, dismantling, and return of all hotel equipment and assets.
Establish contingency plans for adverse weather, traffic delays, power failures, equipment breakdowns, and last-minute changes in guest numbers.
Ensure that all external vendors and service partners adhere to agreed operational, hygiene, safety, and service standards.
Maintain accurate records of equipment movement, inventory, consumption, breakage, and losses for each assignment.
Ensure the outdoor catering experience reflects Fairmont's luxury positioning and service philosophy.
3. Guest Experience & Client Relationship Management
Collaborate with the Sales & Events team to understand client expectations, event objectives, budgets, themes, dietary preferences, and special requirements.
Participate in client meetings, menu tastings, venue inspections, and pre-event planning discussions.
Deliver personalized service to VIP guests, wedding families, corporate leaders, and high-profile clientele.
Ensure prompt and professional resolution of guest complaints, service concerns, and event-related issues.
Build strong relationships with corporate clients, wedding planners, event organizers, and external venue partners to encourage repeat business.
Obtain post-event feedback and implement improvements to enhance guest satisfaction and service delivery.
4. Revenue Generation & Business Development
Work with Sales & Events to identify opportunities for incremental revenue through premium menus, beverage packages, live counters, customized catering concepts, and value-added services.
Support business development initiatives to position Fairmont Mumbai as a preferred destination for luxury events and outdoor catering.
Identify opportunities across weddings, corporate gatherings, private celebrations, and premium off-site events.
Drive responsible upselling and cross-selling while maintaining guest satisfaction and brand positioning.
Monitor event revenue, average spend, contribution margins, and business performance against agreed targets.
Ensure operational feasibility and commercial viability of event commitments and customized client requests.
5. Financial Management & Cost Control
Monitor event budgets, food and beverage costs, labour expenses, equipment rentals, transportation, consumables, and outsourced services.
Work closely with Finance and Cost Control to review event costing, profitability, billing support, and financial reconciliation.
Control wastage, breakage, pilferage, unauthorized consumption, and unnecessary operational expenditure.
Ensure additional services and changes to client requirements are documented, approved, and communicated for accurate billing.
Review event profitability and recommend corrective measures to improve operating margins without compromising service quality.
Ensure efficient resource utilization and compliance with approved financial controls.
6. Food Safety, Hygiene & Risk Management
Ensure compliance with applicable food safety regulations, hotel hygiene standards, and established food handling procedures.
Monitor food storage, preparation, transportation, holding temperatures, display, replenishment, and service practices.
Ensure accurate communication and handling of allergens, dietary restrictions, and special meal requests.
Verify venue readiness, emergency access, equipment safety, fire precautions, and relevant operational permissions.
Ensure appropriate licensing, approvals, and compliance requirements are addressed for outdoor catering assignments.
Report incidents, near misses, food safety concerns, and guest injuries through established hotel procedures.
Conduct regular inspections and ensure corrective actions are implemented within the stipulated timelines.
7. People Management & Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop the Events, Banquet, and Outdoor Catering team to deliver consistent luxury service.
Prepare manpower plans and duty rosters aligned with event schedules, business volumes, and productivity requirements.
Conduct pre-shift briefings, service training, performance discussions, and on-the-job coaching.
Identify training needs in banquet service, outdoor catering logistics, guest engagement, upselling, and event execution.
Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, grooming, discipline, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate with People & Culture on recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, and colleague engagement.
Ensure fair workload distribution and adherence to hotel policies and applicable employment requirements.
Promote Fairmont's Heartist culture by encouraging respectful collaboration, colleague well-being, and service excellence.
8. Inventory & Operational Asset Management
Maintain accurate inventories of banquet equipment, crockery, cutlery, linen, furniture, portable bars, buffet equipment, and outdoor catering assets.
Ensure proper storage, cleanliness, maintenance, and availability of equipment for upcoming events.
Coordinate with Stewarding, Engineering, Purchasing, and approved vendors for repairs, servicing, rentals, and replacement requirements.
Implement standard checklists for event preparation, equipment dispatch, setup, dismantling, and reconciliation.
Monitor equipment utilization and minimize losses, breakage, and unnecessary replacement costs.
Ensure responsible waste management and sustainable operating practices, including reducing food waste and unnecessary single-use materials.
9. Reporting, Standards & Continuous Improvement
Ensure adherence to Fairmont brand standards, Accor policies, hotel SOPs, grooming guidelines, and service protocols.
Monitor guest satisfaction, event revenue, profitability, cost variances, operational productivity, and audit performance.
Prepare event performance reports, cost analyses, incident reports, inventory reconciliations, and management updates.
Conduct regular operational reviews and implement action plans to address service gaps and recurring issues.
Maintain accurate records of event requirements, client approvals, staffing deployment, equipment movement, and operational exceptions.
Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, operational efficiency, event concepts, and client experience.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of assigned event revenue and outdoor catering business targets.
Guest satisfaction, client feedback, and event experience scores.
Event profitability and adherence to food, beverage, and labour cost budgets.
Incremental revenue generation through upselling and customized offerings.
Accuracy of event costing, billing documentation, and financial reconciliation.
Compliance with food safety, hygiene, brand standards, and operational audits.
Manpower productivity, training completion, and colleague engagement.
Inventory accuracy and reduction in breakage, wastage, and equipment losses.
Client retention, repeat business, and quality of event execution.
Timely completion of reports, operational reviews, and corrective actions.
Qualifications
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Service, or a related discipline.
Approximately 5–8 years of relevant hospitality experience, including managerial or supervisory responsibility in banquet operations, events, or premium outdoor catering.
Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale weddings, corporate events, gala functions, and off-site catering assignments.
Strong understanding of banquet operations, food and beverage service, event logistics, costing, budgeting, and inventory management.
Experience managing premium clientele, event planners, corporate accounts, and external venue partners.
Knowledge of food safety, hygiene practices, risk management, and applicable hospitality regulations.
Additional Information
Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are an inclusive company, and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Job-Category: Food & Beverage
Job Type: Permanent
Job Schedule: Full-Time Banquet operations Outdoor catering Event planning Luxury hospitality Team leadership Revenue management Cost control Client relationship management Food safety Logistics management Budgeting Inventory management Risk mitigation Upselling Staff training Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel or Hospitality Management. A minimum of 5–8 years of relevant experience in banquet operations, events, or premium outdoor catering is required.

title: Room Division Manager
job_description:
Company Description
Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL - Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.
Job Description
POSITION PURPOSE
The Rooms Division Manager is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across the Rooms Division, ensuring seamless coordination between Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Services, Concierge, Guest Relations, and other associated functions.
As a key leader within the hotel, the incumbent will champion the Fairmont philosophy of gracious, personalised and anticipatory service, ensuring that every guest experience reflects the sophistication, warmth and distinctive character of a luxury hospitality destination.
The role requires a strong balance of luxury service delivery, people leadership, operational efficiency, commercial acumen and brand compliance, with a focus on creating memorable guest experiences, developing high-performing teams and maximising departmental profitability.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Luxury Guest Experience & Service Excellence
Champion Fairmont’s luxury service philosophy, ensuring consistently personalised, intuitive and anticipatory service throughout the guest journey.
Establish a culture of genuine hospitality, attention to detail and meaningful guest engagement, ensuring that every interaction reflects the Fairmont brand promise.
Oversee guest arrival, registration, in-house experience and departure, ensuring a seamless, refined and memorable experience.
Personally engage with VIPs, luxury travellers, repeat guests, loyalty members and guests requiring special attention, ensuring their preferences are understood and thoughtfully delivered.
Drive effective guest feedback management, service recovery and complaint resolution, ensuring timely intervention and sustainable corrective action.
Monitor guest satisfaction scores, online reputation, loyalty engagement and quality audit results, translating insights into measurable service improvements.
Ensure the consistent delivery of Fairmont standards, luxury service rituals, brand service essentials and applicable quality assurance requirements.
2. Rooms Division Operations & Leadership
Provide overall operational oversight of Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Relations, Concierge, Bell Services and other assigned Rooms Division functions.
Ensure seamless coordination between Rooms Division, Reservations, Revenue Management, Engineering, Security, Food & Beverage and other hotel departments.
Monitor room availability, occupancy, arrivals, departures, room readiness, room allocation, VIP movements and special guest requests to ensure operational preparedness.
Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, room presentation, maintenance, public-area appearance and overall product condition.
Ensure effective management of room discrepancies, out-of-order rooms, room moves, upgrades, overbooking situations and guest requests.
Conduct regular operational inspections, service observations and departmental reviews to identify opportunities for improvement.
Establish clear operating procedures, service standards, escalation protocols and accountability measures across all Rooms Division functions.
Ensure that operational decisions prioritise guest comfort, colleague safety, service quality and commercial performance.
3. Luxury Housekeeping & Product Presentation
Ensure guest rooms, suites, corridors, public areas and associated facilities consistently meet Fairmont's luxury standards.
Drive meticulous attention to detail in room presentation, amenities, linen quality, turndown service, cleanliness and the overall guest environment.
Collaborate with Engineering and other relevant departments to ensure timely resolution of maintenance concerns and preservation of the hotel product.
Monitor room inspection scores, cleaning productivity, turnaround times, guest feedback and quality audit findings.
Ensure appropriate management of lost and found items, guest belongings, room access and other housekeeping controls.
Oversee the effective use of operating supplies, linen, amenities and departmental resources without compromising the luxury guest experience.
4. Commercial Performance & Financial Management
Contribute to the hotel's rooms revenue strategy in partnership with Revenue Management, Sales and Reservations, supporting occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), RevPAR and overall profitability.
Monitor Rooms Division budgets, payroll, labour productivity, operating expenses and departmental financial performance.
Identify opportunities to optimise room inventory, upselling, room upgrades and ancillary revenue while protecting brand positioning and guest satisfaction.
Ensure effective workforce planning, roster management, productivity monitoring and deployment of colleagues in line with business volumes.
Control departmental costs, inventory, consumables and operating supplies while maintaining the standards expected of a luxury hotel.
Review financial reports, departmental performance indicators and budget variances, implementing appropriate corrective measures.
Contribute to forecasting, annual budgeting, capital expenditure planning and operational business reviews.
5. People Leadership & Talent Development
Lead, inspire and develop Rooms Division leaders and colleagues, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability and service excellence.
Demonstrate visible leadership and act as a role model for Fairmont's values, professional conduct and luxury service standards.
Ensure effective manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, succession planning and colleague engagement.
Identify high-potential talent and establish development plans, cross-training opportunities and career progression pathways.
Conduct regular performance discussions, departmental briefings, coaching sessions and leadership reviews.
Promote a respectful, inclusive and psychologically safe working environment where colleagues feel valued and empowered to deliver exceptional service.
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, the Accor Code of Ethics, applicable employment laws and workplace standards.
Collaborate with People & Culture to address employee relations matters, training requirements, engagement opportunities and performance concerns.
6. Brand Standards, Quality Assurance & Compliance
Ensure compliance with Fairmont brand standards, Accor operating procedures, quality assurance requirements and applicable luxury hospitality benchmarks.
Lead departmental readiness for internal and external quality audits, inspections and brand assessments.
Review audit findings, guest feedback trends and operational gaps, ensuring clear ownership, corrective action and timely closure.
Maintain effective controls relating to guest privacy, data protection, key management, cash handling, billing accuracy, security and incident reporting.
Ensure compliance with fire and life safety procedures, emergency response protocols, hygiene requirements and applicable statutory regulations.
Promote responsible and sustainable operating practices in line with the hotel's environmental and social commitments.
7. Interdepartmental Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
Work closely with the Director of Operations, Hotel Manager and Executive Committee to achieve the hotel's strategic, operational and financial objectives.
Establish strong working relationships with Revenue Management, Sales, Reservations, Engineering, Food & Beverage, Finance, Security and People & Culture.
Partner with the Reservations and Revenue teams to optimise room allocation, inventory utilisation, upselling and guest preference management.
Coordinate with Sales and Events teams to ensure seamless execution of VIP arrivals, group movements, events and special guest requirements.
Ensure timely communication of operational priorities, guest concerns, incidents and service recovery measures to relevant stakeholders.
Represent the Rooms Division in operational meetings, business reviews, quality discussions and strategic planning sessions.
8. Innovation, Continuous Improvement & Guest Personalisation
Identify opportunities to enhance the guest journey through service innovation, digital solutions, process improvement and personalised hospitality.
Use guest profiles, preference history, feedback and operational data to anticipate needs and create tailored experiences.
Encourage teams to develop thoughtful, distinctive service touches that elevate the Fairmont experience beyond standard expectations.
Review emerging luxury hospitality trends and benchmark service practices to maintain competitiveness and relevance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance guest satisfaction, colleague productivity, operational consistency and profitability.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated against agreed hotel and departmental targets, including:
Guest satisfaction, online reputation and loyalty engagement scores.
Fairmont brand compliance, quality assurance and LQA audit performance, as applicable.
Rooms Division operational excellence and service delivery standards.
Room readiness, housekeeping inspection scores and maintenance resolution.
Rooms revenue contribution, upselling performance and inventory optimisation.
Departmental payroll, operating expenses, productivity and budget adherence.
Guest complaint resolution, service recovery effectiveness and repeat guest satisfaction.
Colleague engagement, retention, training completion and internal talent development.
Compliance with safety, security, brand and statutory requirements.
Successful execution of departmental improvement plans and operational initiatives.
Qualifications
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management or a related discipline.
Typically 8–10 years of progressive experience in hotel operations, including substantial leadership experience within the Rooms Division of a luxury or upper-upscale hotel.
Previous experience in a Rooms Division leadership role or equivalent senior operational position is preferred.
Experience in luxury hotel environments, preferably with an internationally recognised hospitality brand.
Strong understanding of Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Relations, Concierge and overall rooms operations.
Experience managing departmental budgets, forecasting, labour productivity, guest satisfaction and quality assurance.
Familiarity with hotel property management systems, guest feedback platforms, revenue systems and operational reporting tools.
Demonstrated capability in leading diverse teams, developing talent and delivering measurable operational improvements.
Additional Information
Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are an inclusive company, and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Job-Category: Rooms
Job Type: Permanent
Job Schedule: Full-Time Luxury hospitality management Operational leadership Front office operations Housekeeping management Guest relations Revenue management Budgeting Team development Quality assurance Strategic planning Service recovery Performance management Stakeholder management Brand standards compliance Workforce planning Financial reporting Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in Hospitality Management or a related field. The role requires 8–10 years of progressive experience in hotel operations, with significant leadership experience in a luxury or upper-upscale hotel environment.

title: Product Lead, UI Platform
job_description:

The UI Platform team develops a set of modular components and frameworks that are used by all Rippling products in web and mobile clients. This provides a consistent, exceptional experience to Rippling customers while allowing Rippling product teams to leverage existing components rather than building from scratch. 

Additionally, you will be responsible for the core Rippling experience; from the homepage that users see when they log in to Rippling on web & mobile to how they navigate to different parts of the product. You will ensure that Rippling users – admins, managers and employees – see value quickly from Rippling.

You will own a suite of Rippling platform products that meet the evolving needs of Rippling applications and the customers they serve
You will uncover product opportunities for our platform to deliver exceptional value to its applications
You’ll be eager to roll up your sleeves and dig into the technical details while obsessing over a simple, intuitive customer experience
You’ll work cross-functionally with virtually every team – across product, engineering, design, marketing, and customer-facing functions – to design an extensible system that can meet the evolving needs of Rippling product teams and our customers 
Qualifications:
8+ years of Product Management experience
Experience working on platform features that are used by other products/developers
Obsessed with providing an elegant user experience with attention to detail and bias toward simplicity
Strong ability to motivate others and drive cross-team execution
Alignment with our leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, We go and see

Product Management Platform Development UI Design Cross-functional Collaboration User Experience Technical Strategy Stakeholder Management System Design Mobile Development Web Development Product Strategy Customer Experience Candidates must have 8+ years of product management experience, specifically with platform features used by other developers. You should possess a strong focus on elegant user experience, simplicity, and the ability to drive cross-team execution.

job_description:
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟭𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 - 𝗥𝘀 𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟭𝟮-𝟮𝟬 𝗟𝗣𝗔)
Experience: 3+ yrs
Location: Remote (India), India
Job Type: Full-time
We are looking for an experienced ASIC / FPGA Design Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in digital design, RTL development, verification, and implementation flows. The ideal candidate will have practical experience taking chip designs from specifications and RTL through verification, synthesis, physical design, and timing closure.
This role combines semiconductor engineering expertise with the development of technical evaluations for AI systems. You will create realistic engineering tasks, develop reference solutions, assess AI-generated designs, and identify functional, timing, and power-performance-area (PPA) issues. The focus is on applying real-world engineering judgement to evaluate how effectively AI agents perform complex chip-design tasks.
Key Responsibilities
Develop realistic engineering evaluation tasks covering RTL design, functional verification, synthesis, physical design, and sign-off.
Write reference implementations in Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL, supported by testbenches, constraints, and expected results.
Define clear grading criteria and validation methods that reflect industry-standard engineering expectations.
Review AI-generated RTL, testbenches, hardware designs, and implementation results to identify functional errors and design weaknesses.
Diagnose verification failures, coverage gaps, timing violations, and suboptimal power, performance, and area decisions.
Evaluate designs against functional correctness, timing constraints, resource utilisation, and implementation quality.
Configure and maintain EDA-based environments that enable AI agents to execute realistic chip-design workflows.
Work with tools from Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens, AMD/Xilinx Vivado, or Intel Quartus, as relevant to the evaluation.
Develop tasks that assess synthesis quality, place-and-route results, static timing analysis, and timing closure.
Identify recurring AI-agent failure patterns and convert them into new evaluation scenarios and more challenging engineering tasks.
Collaborate with engineering and research teams to improve evaluation environments, testing methods, and technical benchmarks.
Automate design flows, testing, and result analysis using scripting languages where appropriate.
Document reference solutions, design assumptions, failure cases, and evaluation methodologies.
What Makes You a Great Fit
3–5 years of hands-on ASIC or FPGA design experience, preferably across multiple stages of the digital design flow.
B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, VLSI, or a related discipline.
Strong RTL development skills in Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL.
Practical experience with design verification, including testbench development, debugging, coverage analysis, and UVM or similar methodologies.
Working knowledge of EDA tools and workflows from Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens, AMD/Xilinx, or Intel.
Understanding of logic synthesis, place-and-route, static timing analysis, timing constraints, and timing closure.
Sound engineering judgement when evaluating power, performance, and area (PPA) trade-offs.
Experience taking at least one project from specification through implementation or tape-out.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain precisely why a design succeeds or fails.

The Senior Product Manager I will help shape and advance reporting capabilities for Nielsen's Ads and Outcomes measurement portfolio. The role will help bring together customer needs, data, design, technology, and AI to create experiences that make complex measurement easier to explore and use.
You will own product work from discovery through launch and adoption. You will work with product, engineering, design, and client-facing teams. The ideal candidate is a self-starter. Define product direction for assigned areas in alignment with business goals and customer needs.
Translate customer, market, and commercial insights into clear product opportunities; partner with Design and Engineering to shape scalable solutions.
Own the roadmap and backlog, making prioritization and trade-off decisions; develop product requirements, and prototypes.
Lead initiatives through discovery, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Use research customer feedback to guide decisions; build alignment across the organization to move these decisions forward through influence.
Ensure product experiences are consistent across user interfaces, APIs, and other delivery channels.
Define product goals, KPIs, and adoption measures, and use them to evaluate impact.
Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify workflows and improve customer outcomes.
Shape connected AI product experiences that bring together related data and insights to help users answer broader business questions.
Contribute to a strong product culture by sharing knowledge, supporting teams, and raising the quality of product thinking.
Qualifications
6+ years of experience in product management.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred; a Master’s degree is a plus.
Experience in SaaS, DaaS, analytics, data products, or enterprise software.
Experience taking complex initiatives from concept through launch and adoption, guiding collaborative teams and influencing without formal authority.
Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
Ability to understand data models, data flows, metrics, and measurement methodologies.
Modern AI aptitude, including familiarity with model evaluation, prompt design, MCP, and agentic workflows.
Comfortable using AI tools to support requirements, user experience design, research, and documentation.
Experience applying customer feedback, product usage data, and business results to guide prioritization and UI initiatives.
Familiarity with Agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha, analytics platforms, or prototyping tools.
Experience in ad tech, audience measurement, or media analytics is preferred.
Ability to explain complex topics to technical, commercial, executive, and customer audiences.
Self-directed, organized, and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous situations.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

job_description:
JOB SUMMARY

 

The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that
creates and executes property-level communications to our customers. Under the
leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes
on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media
channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel. This role helps

resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build
deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify

the selling efforts for the organization. This role also gets to do a little bit
of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce
activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel.
Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy
of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged
the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and
communications campaigns.

 

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

 

Education and Experience

 

Required:

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations,
Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales,
marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or
digital advertising experience preferred

experience preferred.

Job Description
The role
The Senior Analyst will deliver actionable client, market, sector and competitive intelligence to support business development, client strategy and commercial decision-making across Clifford Chance.
The role will combine research, data analysis and commercial judgement to identify relevant opportunities, risks, market trends and competitive developments, including those relating to the firm’s global strategic clients, priority sectors and broader strategic objectives.
Working with lawyers, business professionals and CIBI colleagues globally, the role will help translate information into concise, relevant and decision-oriented intelligence.
The role will also use AI and other technology-enabled approaches appropriately to improve efficiency, deepen analysis and enhance the quality, accessibility and visual presentation of intelligence outputs.

Who you will work with
As part of the CIBI team, you will work with local and international colleagues and stakeholders across the Clifford Chance network.

What you will be responsible for
You will be responsible for delivering business insights on specific business development opportunities and initiatives, by conducting research on existing and prospective clients, competitors and sector/market/product opportunities, client development planning, and providing research-based strategic insights to partners on winning new business and developing existing clients. The opportunities are typically multi-jurisdictional meaning close collaboration is necessary with offices throughout the network.
The role will also require the successful candidate to organise and co-ordinate with global teams, supporting client opportunities, as well as business planning and reporting.

What you will do
Deliver actionable client, company, sector, market, transaction and competitive intelligence to support business development, client strategy and commercial decision-making.
Analyse internal and external information to identify market trends and competitive developments relevant to the firm’s strategic priorities, global strategic clients and priority sectors.
Develop concise insights driven outputs, including client and company briefings, market and sector assessments, competitive intelligence, opportunity analyses and presentations.
Engage with stakeholders to clarify the underlying business need, challenge or decision to be supported and ensure that the scope and format of the analysis are appropriate for its intended purpose and audience.
Use AI, automation and other technology-enabled approaches appropriately to improve research output.
Present information through clear narratives, charts and other appropriate visual formats that make findings and implications easy to understand.
Apply appropriate research, analytical and quality-control methodologies, ensuring that insights are evidence-based, sources are reliable and outputs meet the firm’s quality standards.
Collaborate with CIBI colleagues and other teams across the firm to obtain market-specific expertise, validate findings, share knowledge and contribute to multi-jurisdictional assignments.
Contribute to the continued development of CIBI’s intelligence capabilities by identifying improvements to research methods, analytical frameworks, technology use, knowledge resources and working practices.
Maintain relevant knowledge resources and intelligence repositories so that validated information and learning can be reused effectively across the team.
Manage multiple assignments effectively, communicate progress and potential constraints proactively and deliver work in line with agreed priorities, timelines and quality expectations.
Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, information security and compliance with firm policies and information-governance requirements.
Qualifications
Your experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, commerce, management, data analytics or another relevant discipline.
Approximately two years of relevant experience in business intelligence, market or competitive intelligence, consulting research, commercial analysis, financial research, knowledge services or a comparable professional environment.
Exposure to company research, industry analysis, market intelligence or transaction-related research assignments.
Experience of supporting business development, client strategy, market assessment, competitor analysis, strategic planning or other commercially focused initiatives is desirable.
Experience of producing concise briefings, presentations or analytical outputs for senior or time-constrained stakeholders.
Familiarity with business and financial information sources such as Capital IQ, Mergermarket, Bloomberg, Nexis or comparable platforms is preferred.
Experience of using AI-enabled tools, analytical technologies or data-visualisation techniques to support research and analysis is desirable.
Strong research and analytical skills.
Ability to identify relevant information from multiple sources and synthesise findings effectively.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Basic understanding of business strategy frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE and Porter's Five Forces.
Customer-focused approach with a service-oriented mindset.
Ability to work effectively within global and cross-functional teams.
Good time management and prioritisation skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
High standards of professionalism, confidentiality and integrity.
How we will support you
From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and development your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills-based and technical training and on the job learning.
You can also get involved in a variety of employee affinity groups. There is also opportunity to be part of charitable events and volunteering.

We comply with the law and regulations in every location where we operate and we are committed to delivering fair and equal access to all applicants and employees irrespective of background. This applies across all aspects of employment from recruitment and selection to development, progression, and day-to-day working life.

title: Industrial Partnerships Manager, Coimbatore
job_description:
ROLE SNAPSHOT

We are hiring one senior, field based person to open the doors of Coimbatore's manufacturing units for our physical AI data collection program.


ABOUT DATACLAP AND THE PROGRAM

DATACLAP is a Coimbatore based AI data services company. We provide data annotation, human feedback and quality assurance to AI and robotics companies in North America and Europe.

Robots are now being trained to do real factory work: machining, assembly, fitting, welding, soldering, packing and inspection. To learn, they need recordings of skilled people doing these tasks on real shop floors. We are building a network of manufacturing units in and around Coimbatore where our team records this work, with the owner's permission and on agreed terms.

We record hands, tools and task movements, not product drawings or trade secrets. Every partner signs a clear agreement covering confidentiality, timings, payment and worker consent. Partner units earn extra income from floor time and equipment they already have.


THE ROLE

You will be our face to Coimbatore's industry. You will find the right units, earn the trust of their owners, negotiate access and keep every partnership healthy. Most of your week is on the road: in SIDCO estates, job work sheds, foundries, machine shops and larger plants across Ganapathy, Kurichi, Thudiyalur, Peelamedu, Sulur, Malumichampatti and beyond.

This is not a desk sales job. It suits someone who already knows who runs what in this city, who can sit with a 15 person machine shop owner over tea and also present to a plant head at a large group company.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Map the cluster. Build and maintain a list of target units by process type (CNC and VMC machining, conventional lathe work, fabrication and welding, foundry, electrical assembly, pump and motor assembly, textile machinery, inspection).

 * Open doors. Use your existing network and industry associations to get introductions to owners, partners and plant heads of both small job work units and larger manufacturers.

 * Pitch and persuade. Explain the program in simple Tamil or English, handle concerns about confidentiality, production disruption and worker privacy, and turn interest into a yes.

 * Negotiate access agreements. Agree on recording hours, floor space, machine usage, fees to the unit, payment to participating workers and confidentiality terms, then get agreements signed.

 * Onboard sites. Coordinate the first visit, site walkthrough and setup with our operations team so recording starts smoothly and safely.

 * Recruit participants. Help identify skilled operators, fitters and technicians willing to be recorded, and make sure consent is properly collected.

 * Own the relationships. Visit active partners regularly, solve problems quickly, keep payments and paperwork on time and renew or expand agreements.

 * Keep the pipeline visible. Track every unit from first contact to active site in our tracker, and share a short weekly update on visits, conversions and site health.

 * Feed back from the field. Tell us which industries, tasks and pricing work best so we can sharpen the offer.


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 * 10+ years of work in Coimbatore's manufacturing ecosystem, in vendor development, industrial sales, purchase, supply chain, marketing or channel management.

 * An existing, active network of owners and decision makers in local manufacturing units, from small job work shops to large plants. You should be able to name at least 20 units you could get a meeting with in your first month.

 * A proven record of persuading business owners to say yes, and of keeping those relationships going for years.

 * Fluent Tamil and good working English, spoken and written.

 * Comfortable on shop floors and with how small units actually run: job work, outsourcing, shift patterns, cash flow and owner priorities.

 * Willing to be in the field at least 4 days a week, with your own two wheeler or car (travel costs reimbursed).

 * Organised and disciplined about follow up, using Excel, Google Sheets or a simple CRM.

 * High integrity and discretion. Partners will trust you with access to their premises and people.


NICE TO HAVE

 * Diploma or degree in mechanical, production or electrical engineering.

 * Active membership or contacts in industry bodies such as CODISSIA, SIEMA, COINDIA or local estate associations.

 * Experience with both MSME job work units and larger OEM or Tier 1 supplier plants.

 * Working Hindi, to speak with the many migrant skilled workers on Coimbatore shop floors.

 * Some exposure to technology companies, startups or new business models, and curiosity about AI and robotics.


WHAT WE OFFER AND HOW TO APPLY

 * A fixed monthly salary plus an incentive for every partner site that goes live and stays active.

 * Full reimbursement of field travel.

 * A founding role in a new line of business, with the chance to build and lead a field team as the network grows.

 * Direct work with the founder, and a front row seat in physical AI and robotics.

To apply, send your CV(hr@data-clap.com) with a short note (half a page is enough) answering two questions:

 1. Which kinds of manufacturing units in Coimbatore can you get us into in your first 30 days? Types and areas are enough; no names needed.

 2. Tell us about one business owner you persuaded to try something new. What did they worry about, and how did you win them over? Industrial sales Vendor development Relationship management Negotiation Manufacturing operations Supply chain management Business development Channel management Project coordination Data collection Communication CRM Excel Google Sheets Strategic planning Candidates must have 10+ years of experience in Coimbatore's manufacturing ecosystem with an established network of industry decision-makers. job_description:
Job Title: Threat Detection Engineer
Location: Chennai
Type: Onsite, 5 days a week


Our Purpose
India is seeing rapid growth in technology, AI, and digital-first businesses. As
companies scale quickly, strong legal foundations are critical to enable growth
while managing risk.
At Neysa, we aim to build a trusted and compliant ecosystem where innovation can
move fast with the right legal support in place.


Who We Are
Neysa is built by a leadership team that has scaled successful businesses from
the ground up. We believe in moving fast, taking ownership, and solving
real-world problems.
We are building a culture where every team member plays a key role in shaping
the company’s growth and success.


The Opportunity
We are looking for a proactive candidate who can contribute to Detection
Engineering team at Neysa. You will be responsible for identifying threat
vectors specific to Neysa’s business landscape and converting them into
actionable detection use cases across our security stack. Beyond standard rules,
you will perform regular Threat Hunting to uncover hidden threats that bypass
traditional rule-based platforms, subsequently turning those findings into
permanent detection logic.


Roles And Responsibilities

 * Log Analysis: Strong ability to identify threats and exploitability patterns
   within device, application, and server logs.

 * Frameworks: Deep understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK matrix and the Cyber Kill
   Chain.

 * Use Case Development: Proven experience writing and deploying threat
   detection rules tailored to a specific environment’s risks.

 * Threat Hunting & Intel: Solid grasp of log/endpoint-based hunting, threat
   intelligence integration, and basic Attack Surface Management (ASM).

 * Technical Stack: Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, and Threat Intel
   platforms.

For this role, We are looking for a “builder” mindset (Detection Engineering)
rather than a “monitor” mindset (SOC Ops).
Required Qualifications

 * Experience: 2–3 years in a Security Operations Center (SOC), with a primary
   focus on Detection Engineering.

JOB SUMMARY

 

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if
applicable. Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu
planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the
floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and

plan.

culinary, or related professional area.

and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related
major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related
professional area.

 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

 

Managing Day-to-Day Operations

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees'
absence.

• Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room
service areas.

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and
financial objectives are met.

 

Leading Food and Beverage Team

encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making;
demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

members.

work.

• Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.

• Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize
the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.

• Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

• Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.

• Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and
ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.

• Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.

 

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

retention.

service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

relations.

obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall
satisfaction.

• Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.

• Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a
focus on continuous improvement.

• Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of
entry to departure (e.g., greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food

invitation to return).

 

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance
standards and monitoring performance.

• Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or
training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably. Strives to improve
employee retention.

• Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews
employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or
concerns.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.

 

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by
telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and
solve problems.

• Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand
times.

payment of invoices.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. Company Description
Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling the Okta Recovery Vault (ORV). This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.
As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.
Job Duties and Responsibilities
Feature Execution: Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
Component Design: Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
Relationship & State Management: Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
Security & Compliance: Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
Code Quality & Technical Standards: Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
Team Growth: Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications.
Java Expertise: Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in Java and the Spring Boot framework.
Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and caching strategies (e.g., Redis) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.
API Design: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust RESTful APIs for enterprise integration.
Problem Solving & Ownership: Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.
Nice to Haves
Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).
Education and Training
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Function- Operations

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
	
Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004. 
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. 
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour. 
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. 
Position Overview:
	
The Senior Ops Staff is responsible for executing and supporting day-to-day operational activities across Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units while ensuring high standards of shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality.
In addition to performing operational processing activities, the role supports Shift In-charges by assisting in work allocation, coaching newly inducted employees, handling operational exceptions and ensuring adherence to Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures. The incumbent plays an important role in maintaining operational discipline, supporting service commitments and driving consistent execution across operational workstations.
Job Purpose:
	
To ensure efficient shipment processing and operational execution by maintaining high levels of productivity, quality, safety and operational compliance while supporting the Shift In-charge in achieving daily operational objectives and mentoring junior operations team members.
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
	
Operations Execution
• Perform receiving, segregation, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging and shipment processing activities across operational workstations.
• Support loading and unloading of shipments while ensuring safe material handling practices.
• Ensure accurate shipment routing and prevent operational errors and mis-sorts.
• Perform shipment reconciliation and manifest verification.
• Support operational continuity during peak volumes and contingency situations.
Data Entry & Operational Documentation
• Perform operational data entry and shipment updates using company systems.
• Ensure timely and accurate processing of operational transactions.
• Verify shipment labels, manifests and shipment documentation.
• Maintain accurate operational records and report discrepancies immediately.
• Support inventory and shipment reconciliation activities.
Operational Quality & Process Excellence
• Ensure compliance with Blue Dart Standard Operating Procedures across all operational activities.
• Perform quality checks to minimise shipment handling errors and operational exceptions.
• Identify opportunities for improving operational efficiency and workflow.
• Support implementation of operational improvement initiatives.
• Ensure high standards of operational accuracy and productivity.
Coaching & Team Support
• Assist newly inducted Ops Staff during on-the-job training.
• Share operational best practices and promote adherence to SOPs.
• Support Shift In-charges in coordinating daily operational activities.
• Assist in balancing workload across operational workstations during peak periods.
• Promote teamwork and collaboration across the operations team.
Safety, Security & Compliance
• Follow all operational safety standards and Blue Dart security procedures.
• Ensure safe handling and movement of shipments.
• Report operational incidents, damaged shipments or unsafe conditions immediately.
• Promote a culture of workplace safety and operational discipline.
• Ensure compliance with statutory and operational requirements.
Workplace Discipline & Brand Representation
• Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
• Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
• Demonstrate professionalism, punctuality and operational discipline.
• Maintain a clean and organised work area.
• Represent Blue Dart's values through positive behaviour, teamwork and commitment to operational excellence.
Continuous Improvement
• Participate in operational reviews and team briefings.
• Support implementation of new operational processes and technology.
• Share improvement ideas to enhance operational productivity and service quality.
• Contribute towards continuous improvement initiatives across the facility.
• Support operational readiness during business expansion and peak seasons.
Qualifications & Experience:
	
Education:
• Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
• 10th Standard or higher qualification preferred.
Experience:
• 3–6 years of relevant experience in logistics, express distribution, warehousing, courier operations or supply chain operations.
• Experience in shipment processing, sorting, scanning and warehouse operations preferred.
• Exposure to handheld scanners and warehouse management systems will be an advantage.
Eligibility Requirements:
• Minimum age 18 years.
• Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking and manual handling of shipments.
• Willingness to work rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
• Basic English reading and communication skills.
• Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application skills.
• Strong understanding of operational discipline and process compliance.
Skills & Capabilities:
	
Technical Skills:
• Shipment Processing & Sorting
• Shipment Scanning & Reconciliation
• Bagging, Tagging & Labelling
• Loading & Unloading Operations
• Basic Data Entry
• Operational Documentation
• Barcode Scanner & Mobile Device Usage
• Basic Computer Skills
• Basic English Reading & Communication
Key Competencies:
• Operational Excellence
• Attention to Detail
• Teamwork & Collaboration
• Coaching & Knowledge Sharing
• Accountability
• Integrity
• Time Management
• Safety Orientation
• Continuous Learning
• Professional Grooming & Discipline

KRAs
	
KPIs
	
Operational Productivity
	
Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence • Throughput Achievement
	
Quality & Accuracy
	
Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Operational Quality
	
Safety & Operational Compliance
	
SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Operational Incidents
	
Team Support & Operational Excellence
	
Support to Shift Operations • Coaching of New Employees • Process Improvement Participation

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform & Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:
Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.

Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.

ABOUT SCANO
scanO is an AI-powered oral health screening platform, backed by the Google for Startups Accelerator. Our technology detects 40+ oral conditions from a scan and is used by dental clinics across 9+ global markets, including India, the UK, the UAE, South Africa and Singapore.
We are a team of 50+ in Pune, and we build the whole stack in-house: the computer vision models, the in-clinic hardware, the practitioner platform and the patient app.
THE ROLE
Every week, dentists and clinic owners reach out to us through our website, campaigns, webinars and expo booths. Someone has to pick up that interest quickly, understand what the clinic actually needs, explain what scanO does, and get the right prospects in front of our senior sales team.
That is this role. You are the first human voice a prospective customer hears, and the quality of that conversation decides whether a deal ever happens.
This is an inbound-first role. No cold call lists, no field visit targets. Outbound calling is limited to people who have already raised their hand: follow-ups, demo no-shows and older enquiries.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Lead handling and qualification
Respond to inbound leads from web forms, campaigns, inbound calls, event enquiries and referrals. Run first-level discovery calls to understand the clinic profile, chair count, patient volume, who the real decision-maker is, and how soon they intend to move.
Product pitching
Explain scanO’s capabilities and value clearly to dentists, clinic owners and healthcare partners. We will train you on the clinical and technical details. What you bring is the ability to make it land inside a five-minute phone call.
Pipeline management
Book qualified leads into demo slots with the senior sales team, and own the follow-up discipline that gets prospects to actually turn up.
CRM hygiene
Log call notes, lead stage, qualification detail and next actions accurately, on the same day. Our forecasting depends on it.
Market feedback
Report recurring objections, pricing pushback, competitor mentions and feature requests to the marketing, product and sales teams. You hear the market before anyone else here does.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience: 1 to 2 years in inside sales, inbound sales, lead qualification or customer engagement. Product sales experience in SaaS, healthtech, dental, edtech, fintech or B2B is strongly preferred.
Education: Any graduate. Candidates with a BDS, B.Sc or dental hygiene background who want to move out of clinical practice into a commercial role are especially encouraged to apply.
Languages: Fluent English and Hindi. Marathi is a strong plus for Pune, Tamil is a strong plus for Chennai.
Skills: Active listening over talking. Handles objections without getting defensive. Has the judgement to tell whether a lead deserves the senior team’s time, and the honesty to say when it does not.
Work style: Comfortable in a target-driven environment and on the phone for a large part of the day. Adaptable, because a startup changes its process more often than a large company does.
