title: Director - RF Hardware Engineering
job_description:
Important pre-read:
This job description will take ~15 minutes to read and ~15 minutes to apply. You increase your chances of selection by 10x if you read this to the end, slowly. Trust us on this.

What is Armory?
What we are building requires hard work, tenacity, ownership, creativity and way more man-hours than an everyday job.

If you are a savant at what you do, love autonomy, have high agency and genuinely want to impact the future of this country, we want you to work with us starting yesterday!

Modern conflicts waged remotely demand a radical rethinking of strategy as adversaries deploy inexpensive drones and technology to inflict maximum damage with minimal risk.

If you prefer routine over the dynamic unpredictability of innovation, Armory isn't for you. Our fast-paced environment requires genuine curiosity, resilience, a passion for continuous learning, and comfort with rapid change.

Armory is a new age defence tech startup building next-generation products to strengthen Indian forces in the modern battlefields.

About the founder

Amardeep Singh is an IIT Bombay alumnus & an aerospace engineer by education. He was a founding member of ideaForge - currently India’s biggest drone company & the first drone company to get listed on the Indian stock exchange. 

His 16-year entrepreneurial journey is marked by a series of ambitious ventures spanning across diverse tech domains like Drones, Consumer Hardware, B2B SaaS & AI.


Problems we solve

Our country’s defence systems, conceived in a bygone era, have been outpaced by the rapid advancements in technology, revealing critical gaps that we, at Armory, are poised to bridge.

At Armory, we identify and solve the most critical, complex & specific challenges in modern warfare. By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and diving deep into specific problems, we create innovative defence technologies and products that protect our nation and allies.


Why you should NOT join us:


If high stakes, tight deadlines, and significant challenges don't excite you, then our mission to revolutionise defence technology might not align with your career goals. We seek individuals who are ready to push boundaries and are motivated by the urgency of now.


Why you SHOULD join us:

We offer the opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects that strengthen national defence, supported by a team of A players.

Join Armory if you're drawn to solving hard problems and want to create a meaningful & profound impact to the national security.

At Armory, you will do the best work of your life. Period.

Requirements
About this role
You will own the RF engineering function at Armory. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the RF technical vision, build and lead a team of RF engineers, and personally stay close to the hardware. You will be accountable for taking RF systems from architecture to fielded product.
Define and own the RF architecture and technical roadmap across our product lines, including radar, sensing, communications, and counter-UAS systems.
Lead the design and development of RF hardware from scratch (0→1), including transmitters, receivers, PAs, LNAs, filters, RF front-end modules, and phased-array antenna systems.
Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, size, cost, reliability, and manufacturability, and make the final call on RF specifications and component selection.
Build, mentor, and scale the RF team: hire top talent, set the technical bar, and grow future technical leads.
Own the full RF product lifecycle: architecture → schematic → PCB → fabrication → bring-up → test and validation → production handoff.
Establish RF design, simulation, test, and review processes, including design reviews, test benches, and characterization practices that let the team move fast without cutting corners.
Partner with systems, embedded, firmware, antenna, mechanical, supply chain, and manufacturing leads to integrate RF hardware into products.
Stay hands-on where it matters: debug critical issues, review designs, and get on the bench with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes.
Work with the founders and leadership team to shape the product roadmap, set timelines, and manage RF technical risk.
Evaluate and manage vendors, foundries, and component suppliers for RF-critical parts.
Must haves
15+ years of proven experience in RF hardware design and development, with at least 5 years leading teams or programs
A track record of taking RF products from concept to production, not just prototypes
Deep understanding of RF theory, principles, and techniques
Proficiency in RF design and simulation tools such as ADS, HFSS, or CST
Hands-on experience with RF test equipment, including network analyzers and spectrum analyzers
Experience with phased-array systems and RF front-end design
Ability to hire, mentor, and retain strong engineers
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Strong communication and collaboration abilities, from the bench to the boardroom
Bonus points for
Experience designing and developing radar systems
Knowledge of radar architectures, including pulsed, continuous wave (CW), and frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radars
Understanding of antenna design principles for radar applications
Familiarity with radar performance metrics, such as range resolution, Doppler resolution, and sensitivity
Experience in defence, aerospace, or other high-reliability environments, including qualification and environmental testing
Experience building an RF function from the ground up in a startup or high-growth setting
What will make you successful in this role?
Deep technical expertise in RF theory and practice, and the credibility that comes with it
Building a team and assembling an RF system in record time
Making clear decisions with incomplete information
Getting s**t done
How will we set you up for success in this role?
A live project: You will jump straight into live programs as soon as you join. No dummy or test projects.
State-of-the-art tools and technologies: You will have access to the latest RF simulation and design software, along with advanced testing and measurement equipment.
Real ownership: You will have the mandate and the budget to build the function the way you believe it should be built.
Access to resources: You name it, we will do everything to get it for you.
Direct access to leadership: You will work closely with the founders and the CTO on what we build next.
Supportive team: You will be surrounded by the best minds ready to help you.

Our Hiring Process
We target to close the hiring process within 14 days of your application.
Round 1: Screening Application
Duration: At your own pace, but if it takes you less than 15 minutes to apply, you are unlikely to move to the next round.
How to ace: Do not copy-paste your answers from a website or ChatGPT. Be specific in your answers. It’s about you.
Codeword: Use RFLEADS in the application form where it asks you for Codeword. This way we know you have read the JD :)
Round 2: Introduction round
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Be yourself. We want to know YOU, not some ideal unrealistic person. Demonstrate your expertise in the area we are evaluating. Ask good questions.
Round 3: Culture Fitment
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Help us understand your goals and aspirations. Share some of the stories that have made you what you are, including how you have built and led teams. Ask good questions.
Round 4: Technical Interview
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Show curiosity. Walk us through an RF system you architected end to end, including what went wrong. Mention your unconventional projects, interests and more.
Round 5: Leadership Conversation
Duration: 1 hour
How to ace: Tell us how you would build and run RF engineering at Armory in your first 12 months. Be opinionated. Ask good questions.
Offer Stage
Congratulations! You are now a part of Armory. You will build something that lets you sleep at night with a feeling you did something meaningful. Buckle up for a ride into the future.
Work Location
Armory highly values having employees working in-office. We are establishing a collaborative work environment and company culture, and that simply does not happen from home. We are based out of Gurgaon and require employees to be in office.


Benefits
What we expect from you
Genuine curiosity
Founder’s mindset
First principles thinking
Execution, not just ideas
Bias for action
High energy
High agency
Highest level of integrity
Getting your hands dirty
Audacious state of mind
What to expect from us
Team of A players
Work directly with the founder
Ridiculous levels of responsibility
Fast & decisive approach
Work on hard problems

What your first 3 months at Armory will look like
30 Days
Complete onboarding, learn our mission and values, and meet the founder, the CTO, and your cross-functional counterparts.
Audit the current state of RF: live projects, tools, equipment, vendors, and open technical risks.
Meet every RF engineer one-on-one and form a view of the team’s strengths and gaps.
Own the RF system specs for the priority program and present your assessment of the current architecture.
Make the key architecture, component, and procurement calls so no time is lost waiting.
60 Days
Have a working RF hardware prototype assembled, with the team executing under your direction.
Collaborate with the DSP and firmware teams to showcase a “Hello World” of the working prototype.
Put core RF processes in place: design reviews, test benches, and characterization standards.
Present the RF hiring plan and get the first interviews moving.
90 Days
Show the product’s intended functionality.
Integrate RF hardware with the broader system alongside cross-functional teams.
Optimize and tune RF performance based on test results.
Identify cost-reduction and manufacturability improvements, and ready the design for production.
Lead IP development and patent discussions.
Present your 12-month RF roadmap to the founder and discuss your career aspirations with him.

Tips

Irrespective of you applying at Armory or not, some of the following tips will definitely help you in your job search.


How to get hired

Targeted Applications: Ensure your application is tailored specifically for the job you're applying for by understanding its requirements and showcasing relevant experiences and skills. Apply for THIS job, not some job.

Quality Over Quantity: Instead of applying to 100 jobs casually, it’s far better to apply to 4 seriously.

Stand out: Most people don’t put any efforts in applying to jobs, their applications look exactly the same. It’s easy to stand out from them just by putting a little effort and showcasing your relevant experience and interest for the said job.


How to NOT get hired

If your cover letter starts with _“Honestly, I possess all the skills and experience that you’re looking for”_, then you are not going to make it.
In fact, we wrote a long thread on all the ways you will NOT get hired. https://x.com/singhamardeep/status/1459114743398998018?s=46 We highly recommend you to read it.

We wish you the best in your job search! title: Head of Finance
job_description:
About the role
Kantiv is a US SaaS company for the AEC industry. We sell an annual platform subscription. We recently launched AI agents, which customers buy as prepaid credit packs. This hybrid model makes billing, revenue recognition and commissions more complex every month.
You are our first in-house finance leader. You take over all finance work from our fractional CFO, our outsourced accounting firm and our Chief of Staff. You own accounting and the monthly close, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, revenue recognition, commissions and forecasting. You build the finance team as the company grows, starting with your first accountant hire.
We have not billed usage yet. Our price plan is designed. You lead the build of our usage billing on Stripe through the first invoice. You then use real usage and margin data to help us improve pricing.
Location: India (remote), employed by Kantiv's India entity. You work with US-based leaders and US customers.
Responsibilities
Accounting and monthly close
Own the general ledger in QuickBooks and the US GAAP accrual close. Deliver monthly financial statements by business day 10.
Reconcile bank, credit card, payment processor and balance sheet accounts each month.
Post accruals, prepaids, deferred revenue, depreciation and commission entries.
Prepare for a first financial audit or investor due diligence.
Billing, collections and sales tax (order-to-cash)
Issue all customer invoices: platform fees in advance, agent credit packs in advance.
Reconcile credit use in the product to credits sold and to remaining balances each month.
Own collections. Track AR aging, send reminders and escalate overdue accounts.
Manage US SaaS sales tax. Monitor economic nexus by state, apply the correct tax on invoices and prepare filings with our tax tool or advisor.
Collect and store customer tax-exemption certificates.
Revenue recognition and commissions
Prepare monthly revenue schedules under ASC 606: platform fees ratably, usage as consumed.
Track deferred revenue, prepaid credit balances, credit expiry and breakage, and minimum commitments.
Calculate sales commissions on platform and usage revenue each month. Resolve disputes with sales.
Prepare commission capitalization schedules (ASC 340-40).
Post revenue and commission entries in the monthly close.
Accounts payable and vendor management
Process and pay vendor bills on a weekly payment cycle.
Collect W-9s and issue 1099s.
Keep a vendor and contract register: renewal dates, notice periods and owners.
Review SaaS and infrastructure spend. Recommend cuts and negotiate renewals.
Track AI model and cloud costs, which change with agent usage.
Forecasting and FP&A
Own the operating model. Forecast revenue, headcount, spend and cash runway.
Model usage revenue separately from platform revenue: adoption, volume per customer, price per unit.
Prepare monthly budget-vs-actual analysis and explain variances.
Analyze usage, margin and adoption data to recommend price and packaging changes. Build models for hiring decisions.
Metrics and reporting
Track ARR, usage revenue, net revenue retention, gross margin, burn, runway and CAC payback.
Report gross margin with and without AI inference costs.
Own the monthly management pack, the board finance section and investor reporting.
Systems and process
Lead the Stripe Billing build with product and engineering: usage meters, price plans, credits, invoice templates and Stripe Tax. Write the requirements, test the output and sign off before the first usage invoice.
Connect CRM, billing and QuickBooks so that data flows without manual re-entry.
Write the finance policies: approvals, expenses, revenue and commissions.
Team and external partners
Hire and manage your first accountant. Plan the finance team as revenue grows.
Manage external partners: US tax return preparer, 409A valuation firm, auditors and the India CA firm.
Own US sales tax filings, 1099s and annual state reports with these partners.
Own India entity finance with the CA firm: GST, TDS, payroll, ROC filings, statutory audit and transfer pricing.
Support the CEO on fundraising: data room, financial model and diligence answers.
Requirements
Must have
9+ years in finance. At least 4 years at a B2B SaaS company, including time as the senior finance person.
Direct experience with a hybrid model: subscription or platform fee plus usage-based billing. You must give examples of prepaid credits, usage billing or overage billing that you ran, and a billing setup that you helped design.
Revenue recognition under ASC 606 for subscription and usage revenue.
Order-to-cash and AP for US customers and US vendors.
Forecast models that you built and owned, not only updated.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. QuickBooks Online experience.
Clear written English for US customers and executives.
3–4 hours of overlap with US Pacific or Eastern time each working day.
Owned a US GAAP monthly close, not only reviewed it.
Built or rebuilt finance processes at a startup with no existing finance team.
Hired and managed at least one accountant.
Nice to have
CA, CPA or CMA.
US state sales tax for SaaS (economic nexus, Anrok or Avalara).
Stripe Billing and Stripe Tax, ideally an implementation of usage-based pricing. Metronome, Orb or Chargebee experience also counts.
Commission tools: QuotaPath, CaptivateIQ or similar. ASC 340-40 experience.
HubSpot or Salesforce data.
SQL, to pull usage data without help from engineering.
Experience with a financial audit, 409A valuation or fundraising diligence. Financial Accounting US GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606 Stripe Billing QuickBooks Online Financial Forecasting FP&A Sales Tax Compliance Commission Calculation Accounts Payable Accounts Receivable Budgeting Financial Reporting Team Leadership SaaS Metrics Candidates must have 9+ years of finance experience, including at least 4 years in a B2B SaaS company with direct experience in hybrid subscription and usage-based billing. Proficiency in US GAAP, ASC 606, QuickBooks Online, and advanced financial modeling is required.

title: Senior Electrical Designer – SolidWorks
job_description:
Navinyaa Solutions is hiring a Senior Electrical Designer – SolidWorks (Wiring Harness & Systems) with 8 to 12 years of hands-on experience in 3D wire harness design, electrical schematic engineering and cabinet-level system integration using the SOLIDWORKS.
Role Summary
Job Title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer - Harness & Systems
Experience: 8 – 12 years (core hands-on)
Location: Doddaballapur, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka (work from office)
Domain: Gaming cabinets, slot machines, EGM - high-reliability electro-mechanical products
Design Platform: SolidWorks Electrical only (Schematic + Electrical 3D / Routing)
Education: Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech - both routes accepted
Engagement: Full-time or Contract
Notice Period: Immediate joiners preferred

About the Role
You will own the electrical architecture, 3D cable and wire harness design, schematic generation, component selection and design validation for next-generation slot machines and gaming cabinets.
This is a role for an engineer who works comfortably in both worlds - the schematic and the physical assembly. You will route harnesses through cabinets where space is tight, doors swing and drawers slide, and where a wire that chafes through after two years in the field is a failure the operator will feel. Everything is designed in SolidWorks, and the harness you draw is the harness the shop floor builds.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities
A. 3D Wire Harness & Cable Design
Spatial routing: Design and route complex 3D wiring harnesses, looms and cable assemblies within tight, high-density cabinet spaces using SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing.
Dynamic kinematics: Engineer harness paths across moving parts - hinged display doors, retractable player-tracking modules and bill validator drawers - with correct strain relief, bend radii and anti-chafing protection.
Assembly integration: Work inside the live SolidWorks cabinet assembly to validate clearances, service access and interference against mechanical and sheet-metal models.
Production deliverables: Generate 2D formboard and nailboard drawings, Bills of Material (BOM), wire cut lists, sleeve specifications and bundle breakdown sheets for manufacturing.

B. Electrical Schematics & Architecture
Schematic design: Create and maintain multi-sheet electrical schematics and power single-line diagrams in SolidWorks Electrical Schematic - AC mains entry, 12V / 24V DC supplies, UPS backup and logic isolation.
System interconnections: Map wiring between main logic boards (EGM controllers), bill acceptors, thermal printers, player panels, topper displays and RGB LED controllers.
Data integrity: Maintain the project database, component libraries, cabling and terminal-strip data so schematics and 3D routing stay synchronised through design change cycles.

C. Connector & Component Selection
Interconnect specification: Select connectors, pins, headers and terminals (Molex, TE Connectivity, Hirose, Amphenol) for low-power signals, high-speed data and high-vibration environments.
Cable sizing & protection: Define wire gauges, insulation types, shielding, ferrites and sleeving rated for continuous operation.
Manufacturing standards: Ensure every harness design conforms to IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 2/3.

D. Testing, ESD, Safety & Compliance
ESD protection: Implement chassis grounding, shielding and ESD suppression routes that protect sensitive electronics from static discharge at player touch points.
Regulatory compliance: Ensure the electrical layout passes gaming certification such as GLI-11, alongside FCC Class A/B, CE, UL 62368-1 and UL 2200.
Verification testing: Oversee continuity testing, high-voltage insulation and Hi-Pot tests, thermal load limits and signal integrity checks on harness prototypes.

Mandatory Criteria
Education - either route accepted
Route A: Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, supported by 8 to 12 years of hands-on wiring harness design and schematic engineering experience.
Route B: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering.
Diploma candidates who meet the experience requirement are assessed on demonstrated project capability, not on qualification. Both routes are evaluated against the same technical bar and the same software requirement below.

Software Platform - SolidWorks, no equivalents
You must be independently productive in SolidWorks Electrical Schematic for 2D authoring and SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing for harness work, including bidirectional schematic-to-3D synchronisation and automated formboard generation.
Coming from EPLAN Electric P8, AutoCAD Electrical, Creo Pro-Cabling, CATIA V5 EHI, Autodesk Inventor or VeSyS? You are welcome to apply - but you will need to demonstrate working SolidWorks Electrical capability at interview, as these platforms are not treated as substitutes here.

What You Bring
Experience: 8 to 12 years in electrical harness design, schematic engineering and cabinet-level system integration.
SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing: Proven 3D harness routing, flattened-route creation and formboard output within live assemblies.
SolidWorks Electrical Schematic: Multi-sheet schematic authoring, library and symbol management, terminal-strip and cabling definition, report generation.
Standards: Working knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620, crimp validation, pull testing and harness manufacturing processes.
Domain background (advantage): Slot machines, gaming cabinets, ATMs, self-service kiosks, medical consoles or high-density industrial control panels.

About Navinyaa Solutions
Navinyaa Solutions delivers engineering design, IT, finance and BPO services to clients across manufacturing, consumer products, automotive, aerospace, medical devices and industrial equipment. Our engineering practice covers the full product lifecycle - concept development, CAD modelling, analysis, prototyping, design transfer and sustenance engineering. SolidWorks Electrical 3D Wire Harness Design Electrical Schematic Engineering System Integration Cabinet Design IPC/WHMA-A-620 Connector Selection Cable Routing Bill of Materials ESD Protection Regulatory Compliance Thermal Load Analysis Signal Integrity Electro-mechanical Design Schematic Generation Formboard Drawing Candidates must have 8 to 12 years of hands-on experience in electrical harness design and schematic engineering using SolidWorks. A degree or diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering is required, along with a strong understanding of manufacturing standards like IPC/WHMA-A-620.

enters and is distributed across Amazon’s fulfillment network. Our products help

experiences that sellers can understand and act on. You will build responsive,
performant, accessible, and maintainable web applications used by sellers around

engineers, and science teams to take ideas from concept through launch. You will
influence front-end architecture, establish reusable patterns and components,

influence the evolution of a global product, and build experiences that directly
affect how billions of units move through Amazon’s fulfillment network.

development practices.

- Collaborate with engineers across FBA and Amazon to influence technical

You might start your day reviewing customer feedback and operational metrics for

experience.

The problems we solve often span UX, front-end architecture, distributed

The FBA Placement organization owns the technology that determines where and

Our systems evaluate factors including fulfillment cost, customer delivery

title: Software Development Engineer, FBA Defect Prevention

Join a new team and make a huge difference for Amazon, our sellers, and our
supply chain. We are the team that deals with the exceptions to the exceptions
in a complex process, saving Amazon and our sellers many millions of dollars.

The FBA Defects Prevention team within Fulfillment By Amazon is responsible for
identifying and preventing defects in the FBA Supply Chain. We work across
sellers, fulfilment technology, robotics and carriers to detect, root cause,
gather evidence and ultimately prevent issues in the supply chain.

As you can imagine, Amazon's inbound supply chain are incredibly complex and
highly scaled. While most people marvel at the efficiency with which the inbound
processes handle most shipments, we are the team that deals with the exception -
when things go wrong, we're the ones engaged to root cause and identify the
problems.

Examples of defects include sellers sending in the wrong item, failing to label
or mislabeling packages, sending shipments to the wrong location, or failing to
prep them. Detecting that these things have happened are hard - the signals
coming from the network are often contradictory and misleading. We gather
evidence, root cause, determine the ground truth, and then reach out to sellers
to help them correct issues.

We drive projects that save Amazon between tens and hundreds of millions of
dollars through prevention and resolution of these issues, and are critical path
to reducing Amazon's Cost to Serve as well as ensuring seller inbound shipments
are efficiently received and available to customers.

The Defect Prevention space is complex, highly scaled, and ripe for use of new
technologies. We can use Gen AI to analyze patterns, assess root causes,
evaluate image data, and ultimately craft the right message to communicate with
sellers on what has gone wrong.

In addition, this is a problem area that is well suited to someone who is
interested in deep diving complex issues, and then crafting solutions that

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders within the enterprise and familiarity with the CHRO workflows and priorities

job_description:
What makes Gartner Research a GREAT fit for you?
When you join Gartner Research, you’ll be part of a leading-edge team that values expert insights, bold ideas and intellectual courage. You’ll deliver must-have research and contribute to our double-digit growth by providing our clients worldwide the unbiased insight they need to make the right decisions on their key initiatives. Through constant learning, discovery and collaboration you’ll not only help clients deliver on the promise of digital, you’ll grow your career and the scope of your impact across industries. Our culture demands hard work — and rewards it with exceptional opportunity. If you are intellectually curious and principally motivated by ideas, Gartner is looking for you.
About this role:
Gartner is searching for an India-based Principal Analyst to join our global Invest Practice, serving our Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking clients withing our Emerging Technology research group. Operating as a critical engine in Gartner’s 24/7 "follow-the-sun" model (NY–London–India), you will track daily investment activities, decode early-stage tech innovations, and rapidly synthesize Gartner's proprietary research into tailored, high-impact deliverables for Invest Analysts and sales-led initiatives. This individual will work on a wide range of written deliverables. The specialist must be interested in all types of technology innovation and combine strong business and financial acumen with an agile mindset: immersing yourself in one technology trend today, and seamlessly pivoting to the next to match the market's relentless pace. This role is a key feeder to careers reaching the highest levels of Gartner.
What you will do:
▪ Track Daily Invest Activity & Enable Follow-the-Sun Support: Monitor global financial and market developments daily across Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking to support Gartner’s 24/7 global delivery model (NY–London–India).
▪ Curate & Customize Content for Invest Analysts: Translate and tailor Gartner’s technology research, market data, and insights into high-impact, actionable deliverables as well as lead author publications tailored specifically for Invest Analysts and clients.
▪ Fuel Sales-Led & Timely Content Creation: Leverage business and economic acumen to rapidly identify relevant and timely published research for Invest clients that support sales initiatives.
▪ Partner Across Global Stakeholder Teams: Collaborate seamlessly with core Invest analyst team and leadership to ensure timely delivery.
Who you are:
We are looking for creative, analytically sharp, articulate, and self-motivated individuals who want to build a career tracking emerging technology signals and translating them into actionable intelligence for the investment community. You possess a strong passion for tech innovation, early-stage startups, and financial markets, with a keen interest in how emerging trends impact Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking.
Unlike traditional buy-side/sell-side finance, investment banking, or management consulting, our strategic research positions do not depend on deal sourcing or business development targets. Our search for talent centers on your ability to track daily market activity, analyze emerging tech innovations, and deliver rigorous, customized insights that power our 24/7 global delivery model.
Key characteristics of successful hires include:
Strong Business & Tech Acumen: A deep appetite to track investment activities daily and explore early-stage tech trends to extract high-value market insights.
Analytical & Customization Capabilities: Ability to gather, analyze, and restructure complex qualitative and quantitative data to tailor Gartner content specifically for Invest Analysts and sales-led initiatives.
Precision Communication: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex market and technology concepts clearly, logically, and persuasively.
Agility Under Fast-Paced Conditions: Proven competence in meeting tight daily deadlines, multi-tasking across dynamic market trends, and delivering high-quality work in a "follow-the-sun" global workflow.
Continuous Curiosity & Ownership: A drive to constantly learn, adapt to shifting market signals, and take self-motivated ownership of research deliverables.
Preferred Qualifications:
Education: Master’s degree (Business, Economics, Finance, MBA, or Technology-related field) or PhD preferred.
Experience: 5-8 years of experience in market research, equity/investment research (highly preferred), corporate strategy, or management consulting within the technology or financial services sectors.
Methodology: Proven expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, data synthesis, and insight generation.
Domain Knowledge: General understanding of financial markets, investment lifecycles, and emerging technology ecosystems.

title: Staff Backend Engineer (FDE)
job_description:
Engineering, Platform
Full-time
About Meeru AI
Meeru AI is building an AI-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems, including ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, and HRIS, and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP&A leaders.
We deploy on customer terms: SaaS multi-tenant, SaaS single-tenant, and on-premises, across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.
The Role
The Staff Backend Engineer owns the application and API services layer: the services through which everything the platform computes actually reaches a person.
Multi-tenant APIs, authentication and authorization, and the review and approval workflows where a controller accepts a result, challenges it, or sends it back. The computation layer produces the numbers. This layer is where a finance team sees them, interrogates them, approves them, and acts on them.
That means your services carry the same correctness and auditability requirements as the computation beneath them, plus the access control and tenancy guarantees that let a Fortune 500 finance organization trust the platform with their close cycle.
Every action taken through your services is part of an audit trail that sits next to externally reported financials. Who approved what, when, on the basis of which underlying result, and what changed afterward. That is not logging you add later. It is a product requirement, and it shapes how the services are designed from the first commit.
This is hands-on and high-ownership. You own major services end to end, set backend patterns alongside the Senior Staff engineers, and partner with data, AI, and product on the contracts between layers.
Key Responsibilities
1. Own the multi-tenant APIs through which the platform's results are consumed. Design the service contracts between the application layer and the computation, data, and AI layers, and own the versioning discipline that lets those contracts evolve without breaking consumers who cannot all move at once.
2. Build the review, approval, and exception-handling workflows finance teams operate in. This is where the product either earns trust or loses it. A controller who cannot see why a number is what it is will not approve it, and will not use the platform twice.
3. Build and maintain multi-tenant isolation at the service layer. Own authentication, authorization, and role-based access across the application surface. Cross-tenant leakage should be impossible by construction rather than prevented by convention.
4. Build the audit trail. Who saw what, who approved what, on the basis of which result. Guarantee that every user-facing figure links back to its computation and its source, and support the enterprise security and compliance reviews Fortune 500 finance customers run before they buy.
5. Build for a multi-cloud-ready, multi-tenant-ready, customer-hosted deployment model. Services that run inside a customer's environment with strong isolation and no data egress.
6. Own performance, reliability, and cost of the services you build, including observability and operational health. You should be able to answer why a request is slow rather than guessing.
7. Set backend patterns, review designs, and mentor mid and senior engineers. Partner with data, AI, and product on cross-layer service design.
A note on accountability: this role owns the application and API services, tenancy and access control, and the audit trail. It does not own the core computation layer, the data foundation, the AI layer, or product prioritization.
Seven or more years in backend forward deployment engineering, with significant Staff-level time owning complex production services. Owning them, including what happens when they fail.
Demonstrated ownership of services in a multi-cloud SaaS environment, and a clear account of how you guaranteed isolation rather than assumed it.
An obsession with correctness and traceability. You treat "who did what, when, and on what basis" as a first-class requirement rather than an audit checkbox.
Strong API and service design, including versioning, contracts, and backward compatibility. You have evolved an interface other teams depended on without breaking them.
Practical security engineering: authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. Not theory.

title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking
job_description:
Company Description
About Mirantis
Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/
Job Description
About the role
We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.
You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.
As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.
This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.
Key Responsibilities
Reference architecture
Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.
Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.
Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.
Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.
Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.
Host and platform networking
Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.
Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.
Research and exploration
Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.
Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.
Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.
Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.
Code and proofs of concept
Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.
Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.
Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib_write_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.
Customers, partners and community
Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.
Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.
Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.
Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.
Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.
Qualifications
Education and experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.
Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.
Required technical skills
Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.
InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.
RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.
Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.
Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.

About ExamDeveloper

and a technical authority within your area. You lead the design, implementation,
optimization, and support of complex software components, services, and
platforms that enable key business capabilities and customer experiences.

Working with significant independence, you evaluate technical options, guide
design decisions, identify risks, and build scalable, maintainable, resilient
solutions. You are frequently consulted on architecture reviews, performance
optimization, operational stability, and complex problem resolution. You lead
through expertise rather than formal authority — mentoring engineers, improving
practices, and helping teams make sound technical and release decisions. You
partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects,

Location: Remote in India
Role Description: 
ShipBob is building a People Technology & Analytics function from the ground up, and this is the role that leads it. 
Right now, our HR technology and people analytics capabilities exist, but they are distributed and not yet operating with a single coherent strategy. Core HCM lives in one place, Talent in another, Performance and OD systems in another, and a variety of other point system solutions throughout the People function. The data those systems generate is underutilized, integrations between them are inconsistent, and the opportunity to apply AI and automation thoughtfully across this landscape is full of opportunity. The goal for this role is to lead the efforts to close these gaps. 
This is not an HRIS administration role nor a pure analytics function. You will lead building the operating model and function that ShipBob needs while doing meaningful technical work yourself along the way. If you are a player-coach who is energized by building something, who thinks in systems and roadmaps rather than tickets and configurations, and who has a genuine point of view on where AI creates real leverage in HR operations, this role was designed for you. This role reports to the Sr. Director, Total Rewards & HR Tech. 
What you’ll do: 
People systems strategy and roadmap: You are the strategic owner of how ShipBob thinks about its HR technology stack. That means making the build vs. buy calls, sequencing the investments, rationalizing what we have, and developing a point of view on what we need grounded in what the business requires. You will develop and maintain a People Technology & Analytics roadmap that reflects both near-term operational priorities and longer-term capability goals. 
HR technology administration and architecture: ShipBob's current stack includes ADP Workforce Now as core HCM, Greenhouse for recruiting, Lattice for performance and goal management, and a range of point solutions across the HR function. You will be responsible for the configuration strategy, integration architecture, and overseeing the ongoing administration of the full stack. You will also oversee and contribute toward building internal tooling and AI-powered workflows that close gaps. 
People analytics program: ShipBob does not yet have a structured people analytics capability. You will oversee development of data management, metric architecture, standard reporting cadences, and a roadmap of deeper workforce studies. 
AI and automation strategy: ShipBob is actively deploying AI agent tooling through our HR service center and enabling employees across the People team with access to AI-enabled tooling to build self-service solutions for process improvements and automations. You will partner with IT and People Leadership to develop a point of view on to drive long-term value in this space while avoiding redundancy and overspend. 
Organizational design and team building: You will assess the current state of People Technology & Analytics capability across ShipBob and develop a recommendation for what the right team structure looks like over the next 12 to 18 months. You will build the internal case for that structure and navigate the organizational dynamics required to bring it to life. 
People Service Center partnership model: ShipBob's People Service Center (PSC) is responsible for Tier 1 HR ticket resolution, data entry, and knowledge base management and operates adjacent to this function. This work is deeply intertwined with the systems and data this team owns. You will be accountable for defining a clear operating model for how PT&A and PSC work together: what each team owns, how they hand off, and how they complement each other. 
Team leadership: You will carry direct management responsibility for HRIS and analytics talent within this function and are expected to be an active, invested leader in developing the people on your team. Hands-on with firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco or cloud-native firewalls).

Scripting in Python, Bash or PowerShell for automation.

DRAW THE OWL: Own the delivery roadmap for the Compliance Domain, including customer-facing compliance services, internal platform APIs, and Ops Tooling. Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers to translate long-term technical strategy into executable quarterly plans and measurable outcomes.

BE AN OWNER: Take full accountability for your team’s operational excellence, including system reliability, incident response, on-call health, and security posture. Make high-judgment calls that balance speed, quality, and risk.

Ensure resources are aligned to the highest-impact work across all three pillars.

BUILD BRIDGES: Act as the primary point of contact between the Compliance Domain and its stakeholders. Manage relationships with Product Management, external-facing teams, and internal engineering teams that depend on your compliance services and Ops Tooling. Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

About the role
Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 1, you’ll investigate real technical problems across our platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. You’ll learn to trace issues to root cause, communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, and build the judgment to own increasingly complex work independently.
This is not a traditional support role built around scripts and handoffs. You’ll work in one shared CXE queue, use AI as part of your everyday engineering toolkit, and contribute to the knowledge, automation, and product improvements that prevent repeat problems. CXE 1 is designed as a transition into CXE 2 as your depth, independence, and customer readiness become consistently visible.
What you will do
Own standard and moderately complex customer issues from first investigation through resolution and closure.
Debug web application, API, integration, authentication, configuration, and data issues using logs, developer tools, SQL, and established investigation patterns.
Communicate clearly and empathetically across tickets, calls, incidents, and internal channels; ask precise questions, set expectations, and close every loop.
Work with CXE 2 engineers on complex, high-risk, or enterprise cases, taking on greater ownership as your readiness grows.
Create structured escalation reports for confirmed product issues and stay accountable for progress and customer closure when Engineering is involved.
Use AI tools safely to accelerate investigation, validate hypotheses, improve responses, correct support-agent outputs, and strengthen team knowledge.
Turn learning from customer issues into better documentation, runbooks, product feedback, and small automation or tooling improvements.
Protect shared queue health by prioritising accurately, meeting service levels, documenting work cleanly, and helping rebalance work across shifts.
Participate in rotational shifts and on-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.
Who you are
A recent graduate or early-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply.
Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language.
Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications, and how software systems communicate.
Working knowledge of SQL and an interest in using data to investigate and validate behaviour.
Curious and systematic: you want to understand why something failed, not just make the error disappear.
Clear written and verbal communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain language to customers and engineers.
Comfortable asking for review when risk or uncertainty is high, then applying the feedback quickly.
Open to rotational shifts and occasional on-call coverage across a global customer base.

Built a project, script, bot, or automation that solved a real problem.
Worked with logs, observability tools, cloud platforms, SSO/SAML/OAuth, or third-party integrations.
Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar and can explain how you validated their output.
Contributed to an open-source project, hackathon, internship, or production codebase.

You enjoy ambiguous technical problems and are persistent enough to find the real cause.
You care equally about technical correctness and how the customer experiences the resolution.

title: Senior Design Engineer
job_description:
About aion
aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.
We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we’re building the next generation of enterprise AI and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us scale.
We're hiring a design engineer who builds like a founder. You see what's missing and make it exist: you design it, build it, ship it and own it. Code is your design material, and you write a shader when CSS runs out. The bar is an interface that feels physical: it tracks the finger, carries momentum and never drops a frame.
What you'll do
Take ideas from a blank file to production: decide what's worth building, prototype it in code, and own it once it ships.
Build production UI in React and TypeScript, from primitives to complete surfaces.
Build the custom tools that make the team faster: design-system tooling, motion tuners, debug overlays and internal apps.
Tune motion and gestures until they feel physical: momentum, weight and interruption.
Create 3D, shader and generative work where it lifts the experience.
Review every build on real devices at 1× and 2×, and keep it fast, accessible and robust under abuse.
Interaction
You treat interaction design as thinning the layer between intent and software, and your work has moments where the interface inferred what someone wanted instead of asking.
Physics is a toolkit to you, not a style: springs tuned by stiffness, damping and mass; velocity projected on release so a flick finishes the job; rubber banding where a hard stop would feel broken; secondary elements interpolated from the gesture driving them.
You give movement conceptual weight: light things settle quickly, heavy and destructive things resist, and bounce appears only where something was thrown.
Your gestures have three beats, constrain on start, track 1:1 on move, resolve on end, and stay contained: no stray text selection, no triggered neighbours, no pointer lost at the edge.
Choreography is second nature: the primary element answers instantly, secondary elements follow late, exits clear faster than entrances arrive, and a touch of blur hides the seams.
Your restraint scales with frequency and input: touch gets the most feedback, the pointer some, the keyboard almost none, and anything used a hundred times a day loses its animation.
Craft
You build without waiting: when a tool, component or prototype doesn't exist, you make it, and you've shipped things of your own that people use.
Code is your design material. You judge an idea by building and using it, prototype in the browser rather than in static frames, and polish only once the idea has earned it.
You iterate until nothing is left to explore, then have the discipline to choose the simple version from many iterations back.
Robustness is binary to you: you spam every state, scroll too fast, drag past every edge, and cut any detail that can't work every time.
You see at the pixel: optical alignment at high zoom, animations scrubbed frame by frame, and before-and-after captures on every change.
Native first: real scroll over hijacked wheel events, clip-path over animating width, CSS keyframes before reaching for a library.
You study the work you admire by rebuilding it, then make something unmistakably your own.
Engineering
5+ years shipping production front ends, with live work you can link to.
React and TypeScript at expert level, with component APIs that don't lie: contextual props, derived state, variants over boolean flags and compound components.
Motion values and direct DOM updates for anything high-frequency, so gestures and scroll never wait on a render.
CSS in depth: clip-path, masks, backdrop filters, blend modes, scroll-driven animations, container queries and the View Transitions API.
Type and pixels in code: variable fonts, optical sizing, OpenType features, and layouts free of shift and subpixel blur at 1×, 2× and 3×.
Performance as a feature: an 8 ms frame budget at 120 Hz, compositor-only animation, and pages that load instantly because every byte was questioned.
Accessibility as craft: focus rings styled rather than removed, focus moved into overlays and back, full keyboard paths and reduced-motion settings honoured.
3D and creative
Real-time 3D with Three.js or React Three Fiber on WebGL or WebGPU.
Shaders in GLSL or WGSL: noise, signed distance fields, glass, refraction, lighting and post-processing, all inside the frame budget.
Motion studies in After Effects and 3D in Cinema 4D or Blender, so ideas move before a line of production code exists.
Generative and data-driven work in Canvas and SVG, and interactive animation in Rive.
Building for AI
Interfaces for streamed, non-deterministic output: progressive rendering, interruption and retry.
You build daily with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, use them to ship whole tools and products on your own, and review every line they write.
Good to have
Custom tools you built that others rely on: plugins, design and motion tooling, debug overlays, generators or internal apps.
Something you started and shipped yourself: a product, a studio, a library or a side project with real users/customers.
Writing and articles about your craft: essays, breakdowns or notes that show how you think.
Creative coding or generative art.
Open-source work in motion, graphics or UI components.
Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy.
Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally.
Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions.
Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits. React TypeScript Three.js WebGL GLSL CSS Interaction design Motion design Prototyping Performance optimization Accessibility Generative art React Three Fiber WGSL UI engineering Component architecture Candidates must have 5+ years of experience shipping production front-end code with expert-level proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern CSS. A strong portfolio demonstrating real-time 3D, shader work, and high-fidelity interaction design is required.

title: Senior Product Designer
job_description:
aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, Aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform.
We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we’re building the next generation of enterprise AI and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us scale.

We're hiring a product designer for whom UX and UI are one craft. You take a vague problem to a flow that feels obvious, then to screens where every pixel, word and transition is placed on purpose. The bar is software that feels inevitable: nothing missing, nothing extra, nothing a pixel out of place.

What you'll do
Turn ambiguous problems into clear flows, information architecture and interaction models.
Design every state of every screen: empty, loading, partial, error and the edge cases nobody listed.
Own the visual layer: typography, layout, colour, iconography and hierarchy.
Specify interactions and motion precisely enough that engineers ship them as designed.
Build and evolve the design system.
Review what ships at 1× and 2×, and catch the 1 px misalignment, the wrong easing and the clipped label before anyone else does.
Test with real users and iterate until nothing is left to remove.
UX
6+ years in product design, with complex products shipped end to end.
User research: interviews, contextual inquiry and usability testing, planned and run yourself and turned into decisions.
Problem framing: user needs, jobs to be done and success measures defined before any screen is drawn.
End-to-end journeys: journey maps and service blueprints covering every touchpoint, handoff and failure path.
Task flows and wireframes that account for every branch, edge case and error, tested before visual design.
Information architecture: content models, navigation and labelling, validated with card sorts and tree tests.
Interaction design: mental models, affordances, feedback and system status, consistent across the product.
Evaluation: heuristic reviews and usability metrics such as task success, time on task and error rate.
UI
Visual hierarchy: one clear focal point per screen, built with scale, weight, contrast and space rather than decoration.
Typography: type scales, optical sizes, tracking that tightens as type grows, tabular figures, and layouts that hold up at larger text sizes.
Layout: grids, a strict spacing scale, every edge on the pixel grid, and optical corrections where the measurements are right but the result looks wrong.
Colour: semantic colour systems for light and dark themes, and perceptually even palettes in OKLCH or Display P3.
Depth and materials: elevation, shadows, translucency and blur, continuous corner curves and concentric radii, used to show what is interactive and what sits on top of what.
Component states: default, hover, pressed, focus, selected, disabled, loading and error, designed for every component.
Design systems: primitive and semantic tokens, variables and modes, components with real variants, and documentation teams use.
Iconography: a consistent grid, stroke and corner language, with icons drawn to read at small sizes.
Motion: springs rather than fixed durations; fluid, interruptible motion that follows the finger and keeps its momentum on release; clear choreography of what moves first, what follows and what leaves.
Platform conventions: deep knowledge of desktop, web and mobile patterns, and the judgement to know when to break them.
Accessibility designed in from the start to WCAG 2.2 AA: contrast, focus order, larger text, reduced motion and screen-reader labels.
Tools
Figma at expert level: variables and modes, component properties, auto layout, advanced prototyping and Figma Motion.
After Effects, Rive or ProtoPie when an interaction has to be felt, not described.
Designing for AI
Interfaces for output that is non-deterministic, streamed and sometimes wrong.
Patterns that keep people in control: review, correction, undo and honest failure states.
Trust built through clarity, not decoration.
Good to have
Illustration, iconography or brand identity work.
Industrial, print or type design, where tolerances are unforgiving.
Dense professional tools: editors, dashboards, developer products.
Public work: writing, talks or side projects.
Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy.
Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally.
Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions.
Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits. title: Performance Marketing Lead- Sahi English
job_description:
About Lokal
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
About the Role

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Lead who can take ownership of paid acquisition and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate is someone who is hands-on with Meta Ads and Google Ads, understands performance marketing deeply, and can make decisions based on data, experimentation and business outcomes.

You’ll be responsible for managing and scaling campaigns, improving acquisition efficiency and working closely with creative and business teams to drive growth.

What You’ll Do

● Own the end-to-end performance marketing strategy and execution across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
● Plan, launch, monitor and optimize campaigns across different stages of the customer funnel.
● Manage campaign budgets and identify opportunities to scale spends while maintaining efficient acquisition economics.
● Track, analyze and optimize key performance metrics including CAC, ROAS, CPI, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and LTV.
● Conduct continuous A/B testing and experimentation across audiences, creatives, messaging, campaigns and landing pages.
● Work closely with the creative team to identify and develop high-performing ad creatives.
● Analyze campaign and customer data to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps.
● Build actionable performance reports and translate data into clear business recommendations.
● Experiment with new audiences, campaign structures and acquisition strategies to unlock growth.
● Take ownership of performance marketing targets and contribute directly to overall business growth.
● Stay updated with changes across Meta, Google and the broader performance marketing ecosystem.
What We’re Looking For
● 2+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing or Paid Marketing.
● Strong hands-on expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads.
● Excellent understanding of performance marketing metrics such as CAC, ROAS, CPI, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and LTV.
● Experience in independently managing campaigns from setup → optimization → scaling.
● Strong understanding of budget allocation and campaign scaling.
● Experience with audience targeting, retargeting, funnel optimization and conversion optimization.
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.
● A strong test-and-learn mindset with experience running experiments and interpreting results.
● Ability to connect campaign-level metrics with broader business and revenue goals.
● High ownership and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Good to Have
● Experience in scaling a business/product from 0→1 or significantly contributing to growth through performance marketing. ● Experience leading, mentoring or managing a performance marketing team.
● Experience working in a startup, D2C, consumer-tech, app-based or high-growth environment.
● Knowledge of tools such as GA4, Google Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust or other attribution/analytics platforms.
● Experience collaborating with creative teams on performance-led creative strategy. What Success Looks Like
● Efficient and scalable customer acquisition
● Improvement in CAC and ROAS
● Strong campaign and creative performance
● Consistent experimentation and optimization
● Effective utilization of marketing budgets
● Contribution to sustainable business growth Performance Marketing Meta Ads Google Ads Growth Marketing Paid Acquisition Data Analysis A/B Testing Campaign Optimization Budget Management CAC ROAS CPI CTR Conversion Optimization Funnel Optimization Attribution The role requires at least 2 years of experience in performance or growth marketing with strong hands-on expertise in Meta and Google Ads. Candidates must possess excellent analytical skills and a data-driven mindset to manage budgets and scale campaigns effectively.

This role combines people leadership with technical ownership. The manager will
establish a reliable operating rhythm for the team, set priorities, coach and
develop engineers, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure that enterprise
platforms and services are secure, well-documented, measurable, and responsive
to business needs. 

The manager will oversee capabilities including Atlassian products, Jira Service
Management, Jira Assets, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, and related
enterprise integrations and data workflows. 

Key responsibilities 

People leadership and team management 

 * Lead, coach, and develop Enterprise Solutions Engineers in India and across
   the broader team. 

 * Set clear goals, ownership, service expectations, and development plans for
   each team member. 

 * Establish team standards for communication, documentation, quality, delivery,
   and operational follow-through. 

 * Run regular one-on-ones, team meetings, planning sessions, and performance
   reviews. 

 * Build accountability for commitments while creating a collaborative and
   supportive team environment. 

 * Recruit, onboard, mentor, and retain Enterprise Solutions talent. 

 * Coordinate knowledge transfer, coverage, succession planning, and
   cross-training so critical services do not depend on a single individual. 

Portfolio, prioritization, and stakeholder management 

 * Own the Enterprise Solutions team backlog and prioritize work across
   operational support, projects, platform improvements, automation, reporting,
   and strategic initiatives. 

 * Translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery plans, milestones,
   and measurable outcomes. 

 * Serve as the primary escalation point for Enterprise Solutions work and
   communicate status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to leadership. 

 * Establish and maintain an operating rhythm for intake, prioritization,
   delivery tracking, service reviews, and continuous improvement. 

 * Partner with Corporate Support, Product Engineering, Data & AI, Information
   Security, Finance, Human Resources, and business stakeholders. 

 * Ensure commitments are realistic, visible, and delivered with appropriate
   quality and documentation. 

Enterprise platform ownership 

 * Provide governance and technical direction for Atlassian products, Jira
   Service Management, Zendesk, Glean, Power BI, Power Automate, Jira Assets,
   and related platforms. 

 * Ensure platforms are configured, administered, monitored, and improved as
   reliable enterprise services. 

 * Establish platform roadmaps, lifecycle plans, access controls, configuration
   standards, and service documentation. 

 * Oversee provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, vendor coordination,
   and platform changes. 

 * Ensure platform administration follows security, compliance,
   change-management, and data-protection requirements.

   productivity, quality, and business outcomes. 

 * Establish practical standards, workflows, training, and compliance procedures

 * Coach the team to use AI-assisted development and automation tools
   responsibly to improve delivery speed and quality.

   reports, dashboards, and supporting data processes.

 * Establish standards for data integrity, security, accessibility,
   documentation, and report ownership.

Role - Content Specialist – QC
Work Location - Work From Office -Bangalore

About Lokal:

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. job_description:
